listing.name: Lion Guard for all
listing.summary: Adds Lion Guard ship variants and weapons to the Sindrian Diktat faction.
listing.aiSummary: Adds Lion Guard ship variants and weapons to the Sindrian Diktat faction.

description:
Ever wanted the Lion Guard variants to be easier to get? Do you just want the Sindrian Diktat to have access them so you can buy them or be rewarded them by contacts? This mod does just that!

This simple mod adds Lion Guard ship variants and weapons to the Sindrian Diktat. (also make the weapons sellable... yes that is actually a technicality.)

And if you wanted to also want add the Lion Guard variants from Dark Revenant's Ship/Weapon Pack mod to the Sindrian Diktat, there's a second mod you can use to do just that! (requires the mod of course, and yes this has to be a separate mod because the game get fussy when you try to add something to a faction when that something doesn't actually exist.)

Due to how simple the mod is, it should work regardless of game version, as it is only changing things within the game's own framework.

Download:

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SJPzr5i8hJDwtT-XD8c-TFkNjA4wikIO/view?usp=sharing

]

Ship/Weapon Pack addition:

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1EQHLJ5Qymqk8dQddEBm_gDRHYvmcrEjB/view?usp=sharing
